The cartridge keeps one copy at arm9:0x020072c0, kind:function(arm,size=0x4), owned by an enrolled source; rombuild compares this object's body against those cartridge bytes and refuses anything but byte-identical vague-linkage output before discarding the duplicate.

notes: Hand-assembled, not generated by `tubuild.py create`: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main, so there was no candidate id to create from. The schema follows the arm9/dCc_c and arm9/dWipe_c entries, which took the same route.

dClipper is the view clipper: __sinit_02074e84 constructs the lone instance (data_0209f43c in bss), the camera setup path loads its projection parameters through Func_020156DC, and dActor_c::BeforeBehavior calls Func_020150E8 per actor to test visibility.

Func_020150E8 and Func_02015560 stay mangled extern "C" definitions (wall 6az, notes/mwccarm-codegen.md): Fix12<int> by-value parameters keep the free spelling while dClipper.h's member declarations stay the real signatures callers use.
The file is written ROM-descending because mwccarm emits .text in reverse source order under default deferred codegen; the emitted object carries the four methods ascending 0x020150e8..0x020156fc.

The destructor pair and C1 (0x020156fc..0x0201577c) remain enrolled per-function shards: the cartridge's D0-below-D1 order is not producible by any single destructor body (see the daObjKuruma_c manifest note), and the dtor-defining shard stays dClipper's vtable-emitting key function so _ZTV8dClipper/_ZTI8dClipper/_ZTS8dClipper keep their existing owners.
